name: cache-keepalive
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while background tasks run

compactOnCap.title: Compact when the ping budget runs out
compactOnCap.description: Compacts the conversation while the cache is still warm instead of letting it expire. Loses context detail.

keepWarmFor.title: Keep the cache warm for
keepWarmFor.description: How long the pings may keep the prompt cache warm after Claude ends a turn with background tasks running: <n>m, <n>h or <n>d (at least 1m), such as 90m, 8h or 1d. Pings come every 50 minutes, so a duration of 50m or less sends none: the cache's own 1-hour lifetime covers it. The ping budget, a missed ping and overage can stop them sooner. /keepalive <duration> overrides it.

keepaliveScope.title: Scope of /keepalive <duration>
keepaliveScope.description: Where /keepalive <duration> applies unless --session or --machine is given: session (this session only) or machine (every session on this machine until /keepalive clear --machine).
